# Request calls containing foo123

## Description

Reports request call regions that contain the more specific foo123 marker.

## Rationale

This example remains independent from the broader foo rule while sharing its native query.

## Limitations

- This example only inspects text files and does not interpret request arguments.

contains-foo123.help: Review the request marker and use the documented form.

code.source: for matched in rx::find_all(file, "call_region") { if matched.text.contains("foo123") { emit(matched.span, "contains-foo123"); } }
